title: Answer: the structure is checked against controls, never the feeling

statements.text: The physics under the premise is checked, never the feeling. Every rule is finite, integer and deterministic, so every result reproduces exactly. Each deep claim carries a control where the answer should be no, a numerical match counts only through a pre-registered null, a verdict is judged over 17 link starts, and each result is reported as held, partial or failed, with the failures kept.
statements.scope: the experiments in the vibe repository, each with its code
